name: Hunyuan3D 2 MV
description: Multi-view Hunyuan3D 2 shape generation. Upload a 2x2 view sheet (front | left / back | right) or a single front image; empty cells are skipped. Geometry only, no textures.
author: Open Southeners

params_schema.label: Input Layout
params_schema.tooltip: 2x2 sheet: top-left front, top-right left, bottom-left back, bottom-right right. Leave a cell blank to skip that view.

params_schema.label: Quality
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps. More steps = better quality but slower.

params_schema.label: Mesh Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Octree resolution for mesh reconstruction. Higher = more detail but slower and more VRAM.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength. Higher = closer to the input views.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.
